title: Bounded parser portability spike
hypothesis: The exact parser revision can reject duplicate keys without external runtime dependencies.

environment.description: Disposable local fixture environment without network access.

acceptance_criteria: Every duplicate-key fixture is rejected with a bounded diagnostic.
stop_criteria: Stop after the first accepted duplicate-key fixture because the hypothesis is falsified.

adversarial_cases.condition: A nested object repeats one key.
adversarial_cases.expected_behavior: The parser rejects the document without consuming it as authority.

method: Execute the exact duplicate-key fixture using the recorded interpreter and parser revision.
failures: The nested duplicate-key fixture was accepted.

cleanup_or_rollback.strategy: Delete the disposable fixture directory after retaining the bounded result record.

limitations: The spike covers one parser revision and one interpreter only.
non_proven_implications: The result does not assess other parsers, production safety, or project readiness.
